source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == 2 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            cellset = set(cells)
            perimeter = ({(r0,x) for x in range(c0,c1+1)} |
                         {(r1,x) for x in range(c0,c1+1)} |
                         {(y,c0) for y in range(r0,r1+1)} |
                         {(y,c1) for y in range(r0,r1+1)})
            if r1-r0 >= 2 and c1-c0 >= 2 and perimeter <= cellset:
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                        if out[y][x] == 0:
                            out[y][x] = 8
    return out
'''
